title: Packages, nothing declared
summary: DJDL's Packages page on Sep 29, the day before its first package was declared: one empty card that says DJDL declares no packages yet, shows the .pkey/release declaration for a package and the CI publish command, and makes clear there is nothing to turn on.
compare: Same frame as packages.feeds: DJDL's Product context, Ship builds open, Packages active with no count, Distribution accent; the header keeps Service tokens and no switch or New feed button.

The empty card's title says what is true in DJDL's words ('DJDL declares no packages yet'); the text says a declared library or image gets its feed on the next resync, open to Customers, and that there's nothing to turn on.

The snippet is a real package deliverable for .pkey/release (kind: package, ecosystem npm with the six ecosystems in a comment, the scoped name, the tarball artifact match), and its foot gives the publish command with --deliverable and --dir.
One link to the docs for package deliverables; no cleanup callout, no machine or CI cards until a feed exists.
Phone: the card fills the width and the snippet scrolls sideways inside its block.
